messages:
sam: Heads-up — ran the RoPE attenuation sweep across Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen. Found a consistent perplexity cliff for Mixtral at >32k tokens when kernel selection picks the `fast-attn-v2` path. Perf looks good but quality tanked. Posting notes and traces below. :eyes:

marta: numbers and traces?

sam: quick summary (short):
```
model   seq_len  kernel         ppl    kv_hit  token_ms
mixtral  16384   fast-attn-v2   2.1    0.98    3.2
mixtral  32768   fast-attn-v2   5.7    0.94    3.5  <-- perplexity spike
mixtral  32768   safe-attn      2.2    0.96    7.8  <-- slower but PPL ok
qwen     65536   yarn-rope      2.3    0.99    4.0
mistral  32768   fast-attn-v1   2.6    0.97    3.4
```
Also saw KV cache hit-rate drop ~3-4% at the cliff. Profiling shows a mismatch: fast-attn-v2's kernel selection drops to a lower-precision path that interacts poorly with Mixtral's head/kv dim packing.

bench-bot: CI job: https://ci.redwood/internal/rope/205123 — perf tests + longctx evals. job 205123/step-4 shows the regression bucket. :robot_face:

kai: interesting. two hypotheses: (1) quantization/packing misalignment for mixtral heads causing numeric blow-up with linearized RoPE scales, (2) lazy KV eviction + prefix caching causing older KV segments to be reused wrongly for very long contexts.

liam: do we have traceback or kernel selection logs for the run?

sam: yes — pasted selection log snippet:
```
[2025-04-12T22:14:02Z] model=mixtral v=3.1 seq=32768 -> selected_kernel=fast-attn-v2 flags={kv_layout=packed, quant=4bit}
[2025-04-12T22:14:02Z] runtime: falling back to reduced-precision matmul for head_dim=96 -> observed err=3.4e-2
[2025-04-12T22:14:02Z] kvcache: prefix_segments=4 evict_policy=lazy hits=0.94
```

marta: can you attach the raw eval prompt set? want to run a sensitivity curve.

sam: uploaded to the bucket: s3://redwood-eval/rope/mixtral/205123/longseq_prompts.jsonl

kai: proposed quick mitigations:
- force per-model safe kernel mapping: `mixtral: max_seq_fast=32768` (above this, force `safe-attn`)
- tune batching: dynamic batch cap = min(64, floor(131072 / seq_len)) so we don't push micro-batches that flip quant path
- change KV eviction to `--kv-policy=aggressive-window` for 1 canary pool to see if hit-rate recovers

config example:
```yaml
runtime:
  per_model_overrides:
    mixtral:
      kernel_policy: "force-safe-after-32768"
  batching:
    dynamic_batch_cap: "min(64, floor(131072/seq_len))"
  kv:
    eviction: aggressive-window
```

liam: +1 to safe kernel mapping as a hotfix. I'll open a rollback/rollforward ticket and push a canary to dedicated pools. Ticket: https://redwood/ops/issue/RL-2051

bench-bot: longctx eval results (excerpt):
```
job 205123: mixtral@32768 fast-attn-v2 -> perplexity +160% vs baseline
job 205123: mixtral@32768 safe-attn     -> perplexity +5% vs baseline
job 205123: qwen@65536 yarn-rope       -> no regression
```

marta: I'll run the sensitivity sweep for head_dim packing and try repro with `--kv-eager-evict` and `--disable-quant-path` flags. Will post results by EOD. :mag_right:

sam: awesome. Action items: 
- liam -> RL-2051 canary + rollback plan (deploy safe kernel for Mixtral above 32k)
- marta -> sensitivity sweep + run eval set with `--kv-eager-evict`
- kai -> prepare batching heuristic PR and runtime switch pseudocode for per-model kernel mapping
- sam -> collect numeric diffs and add to model-catalog safe-range metadata (mixtral.max_safe_fast_seq=32768)

liam: started RL-2051, tagging infra and oncall. Rolling canary to 10% of dedicated pools now. :rocket:

sam: thanks — if anyone sees other models hit cliffs, ping here. Qwen and Mistral look fine for now, so may be mixtral-specific packing issue.

marta: noted. will report back. :white_check_mark:

kai: also logged a follow-up profiler task: PERF-2059 to add head/kv dim validation during kernel selection so we can reject unsafe fast paths earlier.

sam: closing the loop later today with updated numbers. thanks team.
